abstract: Monitors municipal emergency mobilization rates and commercial lease compensation claims
system_message:
You are the Disaster Relief Finance Officer (FIN), responsible for monitoring municipal emergency mobilization rates, commercial lease compensation claims, and municipal liability bond indemnification records for prospective emergency reception hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors municipal emergency mobilization rates and commercial lease compensation claims（RELIEF）
information_points.content:
FIN-RELIEF-J04：For the Penticton Trade and Event Pavilion, the contractual daily facility usage fee charged to the regional district during the emergency mobilization declaration phase is 6,200 CAD/d.
FIN-RELIEF-IAV：For the Vernon Regional Agriplex Arena, the contractual daily facility usage fee charged to the regional district during the emergency mobilization declaration phase is 3,500 CAD/d.
FIN-RELIEF-INA：For the South Okanagan Recreation Complex, the contractual daily facility usage fee charged to the regional district during the emergency mobilization declaration phase is 6,200 CAD/d.

information_points.title: Liability bond indemnification（INSUR）
information_points.content:
FIN-INSUR-UKS：Under the municipal commercial insurance policy for the designated emergency operations period, the Vernon Regional Agriplex Arena has a total underwritten third-party general liability emergency incident liability coverage limit of 20 M CAD.
FIN-INSUR-FCJ：Under the municipal commercial insurance policy for the designated emergency operations period, the South Okanagan Recreation Complex has a total underwritten third-party general liability emergency incident liability coverage limit of 10 M CAD.
FIN-INSUR-CDU：Under the municipal commercial insurance policy for the designated emergency operations period, the Penticton Trade and Event Pavilion has a total underwritten third-party general liability emergency incident liability coverage limit of 15 M CAD.
